BiblicalUsage: The word theiótēs carries the sense of divinity, the godhead. In Romans 1:20, even his eternal power and Godhead.
TheologicalSignificance: Creation itself declaring God's eternal power and godhead leaves me without excuse, and honestly without words, before Him.
